text:
44. A violation of the anti-defection law will not result in a member of the House being:
(A) Disqualified from the House
(B) Disqualified from holding any election campaign for the duration of the period commencing
from the date of their disqualification till the date on which the term of their office as a
member of the House would expire or till the date on which they contest election to a
House and are declared elected, whichever is later.
(C) Disqualified from holding any remunerative political post for the duration of the period
commencing from the date of their disqualification till the date on which the term of their
office as a member of the House would expire or till the date on which they contest
election to a House and are declared elected, whichever is earlier.
(D) Disqualified from being appointed as a Minister for the duration of the period commencing
from the date of their disqualification till the date on which the term of their office as a
member of the House would expire or till the date on which they contest election to a
House and are declared elected, whichever is earlier.
